batch: OLP-0084–0097 First-order Logic natural deduction under the complete classical first-order profile
method: Fresh comparison of every exact frozen-English and Gujarati linguistic block, with selected independently worded reverse paraphrases focused on tree direction, rule arity, discharge dependencies, eigenvariable scope, proof-theoretic quantifiers, semantic polarity, identity substitution and all six adjacent disclosed source repairs.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The chapter presents natural deduction in the Gentzen/Prawitz tradition.
samples.assessment: Chapter identity, Gentzen/Prawitz scope and the prfND profile are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Natural-deduction proofs start from assumptions, apply inference rules and may discharge assumptions under the designated rules.
samples.assessment: Assumptions, discharge permissions, rule premises and conclusions, and tree orientation are preserved after OLND-001.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A natural-deduction derivation is a sentence tree whose lower sentence follows from one, two or three premise sentences by a correct rule; OLND-001 reads the copied word 'sequents' as 'sentences'.
samples.assessment: Assumptions, discharge permissions, rule premises and conclusions, and tree orientation are preserved after OLND-001.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Negation introduction concludes a negated sentence, whereas classical contradiction concludes a positive sentence, even though the rule shapes are similar.
samples.assessment: Every propositional introduction and elimination rule retains its connective, arity, discharge marker and classical or intuitionistic role.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A rule's discharge annotation permits discharging any matching assumptions, including none; it does not require discharge.
samples.assessment: Every propositional introduction and elimination rule retains its connective, arity, discharge marker and classical or intuitionistic role.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Universal introduction uses a fresh constant absent from both its conclusion and every still-open assumption of the premise derivation.
samples.assessment: Closed-term restrictions, eigenvariable freshness scope, substitution convention and the invalid counterexample are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Existential elimination uses a fresh constant absent from the existential premise, the conclusion and all open assumptions except the temporary A(a) assumptions.
samples.assessment: Closed-term restrictions, eigenvariable freshness scope, substitution convention and the invalid counterexample are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Existential introduction and universal elimination accept arbitrary closed terms, while the two eigenvariable rules need freshness; dropping it yields the displayed invalid inference.
samples.assessment: Closed-term restrictions, eigenvariable freshness scope, substitution convention and the invalid counterexample are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A derivation from Gamma is a finite sentence tree whose leaves lie in Gamma or are discharged, whose root is the conclusion and whose internal steps instantiate rules correctly.
samples.assessment: The inductive and finite-tree definitions, open-assumption condition and optional nature of discharge are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Conditional introduction can discharge an occurrence of its antecedent assumption; the examples contrast which of C and D is discharged.
samples.assessment: The inductive and finite-tree definitions, open-assumption condition and optional nature of discharge are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The first worked proof eliminates the assumed conjunction to A and then introduces the conditional, discharging that conjunction assumption.
samples.assessment: Backward proof-search choices, branch dependencies, discharge labels and exercise formulas agree after OLND-002 and OLND-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: In the middle branch, A and not-A yield falsity by negation elimination, and falsity yields B before conditional introduction.
samples.assessment: Backward proof-search choices, branch dependencies, discharge labels and exercise formulas agree after OLND-002 and OLND-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Classical contradiction discharges a negated target and is the feature omitted by intuitionistic logic; the worked classical proofs use it where direct introduction rules cannot close the goal.
samples.assessment: Backward proof-search choices, branch dependencies, discharge labels and exercise formulas agree after OLND-002 and OLND-003.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The quantified example derives not-forall A from exists not-A and then introduces the outer conditional; OLND-004 restores the missing negation in the existential premise.
samples.assessment: Quantifier proof order, eigenvariable dependencies and every displayed formula agree after OLND-004 and OLND-005.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The eigenvariable check applies to existential elimination, and the chosen a occurs in none of the assumptions on which that inference depends; OLND-005 restores the defined rule macro.
samples.assessment: Quantifier proof order, eigenvariable dependencies and every displayed formula agree after OLND-004 and OLND-005.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Universal elimination instantiates the second premise at a, modus ponens obtains C(a,b), and existential introduction closes the subderivation needed by existential elimination.
samples.assessment: Quantifier proof order, eigenvariable dependencies and every displayed formula agree after OLND-004 and OLND-005.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A theorem is a sentence with a natural-deduction derivation in which every assumption is discharged.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, structural properties, transitivity and compactness quantifiers are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Gamma derives A when a derivation concludes A and every assumption is either discharged or belongs to Gamma.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, structural properties, transitivity and compactness quantifiers are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Transitivity substitutes a derivation of A from Gamma into a derivation of B from A together with Delta, leaving open assumptions only in Gamma union Delta.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, structural properties, transitivity and compactness quantifiers are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Proof-theoretic compactness follows because each finite derivation has only finitely many open assumptions; inconsistency therefore has a finite witness.
samples.assessment: Theoremhood, derivability, consistency, structural properties, transitivity and compactness quantifiers are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma derives A, adjoining not-A yields falsity by negation elimination and hence inconsistency.
samples.assessment: All inconsistency equivalences and the directions of negation introduction, elimination and classical contradiction are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: If Gamma together with not-A is inconsistent, classical contradiction discharges not-A and derives A from Gamma alone.
samples.assessment: All inconsistency equivalences and the directions of negation introduction, elimination and classical contradiction are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Disjunction elimination splits on A or B; each branch contradicts its matching negation and derives falsity, proving the three-premise set inconsistent.
samples.assessment: Conjunction, disjunction and conditional derivability claims and their witnessing proof trees are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Not-A derives A-implies-B through falsity and explosion, while B derives the same conditional without using its temporary A assumption.
samples.assessment: Conjunction, disjunction and conditional derivability claims and their witnessing proof trees are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Strong generalization requires c to occur in neither Gamma nor A(x): a derivation of A(c) may then be followed by universal introduction.
samples.assessment: Strong generalization keeps both freshness restrictions, and both quantifier derivability directions are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Soundness says that a conclusion derivable from open assumptions Gamma is a semantic consequence of Gamma.
samples.assessment: The induction measure, semantic polarity, assumption unions and checked rule cases preserve soundness after OLND-006.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: For negation introduction, if Gamma and A semantically forced falsity, any model of Gamma must make A false and therefore make not-A true.
samples.assessment: The induction measure, semantic polarity, assumption unions and checked rule cases preserve soundness after OLND-006.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Universal introduction varies the fresh constant's interpretation to an arbitrary domain object; freshness keeps Gamma fixed and extensionality transfers A(a) to A(x).
samples.assessment: The induction measure, semantic polarity, assumption unions and checked rule cases preserve soundness after OLND-006.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Conjunction introduction combines premise derivations from Gamma1 and Gamma2, so every model of their union satisfies both conjuncts and hence the conjunction.
samples.assessment: The induction measure, semantic polarity, assumption unions and checked rule cases preserve soundness after OLND-006.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Conditional elimination combines A-implies-B from Gamma1 with A from Gamma2, so a model of their union satisfies B.
samples.assessment: The induction measure, semantic polarity, assumption unions and checked rule cases preserve soundness after OLND-006.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The consistency corollary is contraposed: a derivation of falsity from Gamma would make any model of Gamma satisfy falsity, which no structure does.
samples.assessment: The induction measure, semantic polarity, assumption unions and checked rule cases preserve soundness after OLND-006.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: From s=t and A(s), equality elimination derives A(t), expressing substitutability of identicals or Leibniz's law.
samples.assessment: Identity introduction, substitution of identicals, symmetry, transitivity and unique-existence reasoning are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The backwards derivation turns existence of an A-object identical to every A-object into the claim that any two A-objects are identical.
samples.assessment: Identity introduction, substitution of identicals, symmetry, transitivity and unique-existence reasoning are preserved.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: When equality elimination concludes A(t2), soundness uses equality of the term values and formula extensionality to transfer truth from A(t1) to A(t2).
samples.assessment: Identity soundness preserves closed-term scope, equality of term values and the extensionality transfer to A(t2).
